cross_resource_issues.description: All three maps map Observation.status using source element variantStatus but use different transform approaches: genotyp uses copy while mutationslast and variante use translate with cm-status-e6034a1f ConceptMap. This creates inconsistent status values.
cross_resource_issues.fix_recommendation: Standardize on translate transform with cm-status-e6034a1f across all Observation maps for consistency with other validated maps (therapeutische-implikation, diagnostische-implikation)

cross_resource_issues.description: All Observation maps reference Patient for subject element but no Patient profile or mapping exists in the generated set. While this must remain as TODO placeholder, all maps should document consistent resolution strategy.
cross_resource_issues.fix_recommendation: Add consistent documentation comment across all TODO-resolve-reference-Observation-subject rules specifying expected Patient identifier format and bundle assembler requirements

cross_resource_issues.description: All three maps use tmbValue source field but create different extension structures: genotyp creates modifierExtension-valueSampledData-origin, mutationslast creates both effective[x] and value[x].origin extensions, variante creates similar duplicate structure. This may result in inconsistent Observation.value elements.
cross_resource_issues.fix_recommendation: Create shared naming convention for TMB-related extensions across all Observation maps and decide on single canonical location (value[x].extension vs value[x].origin)

cross_resource_issues.description: Both maps use cm-status-e6034a1f ConceptMap for status translation, which is consistent with validated maps (therapeutische-implikation, mutationslast). However diagnostische-implikation should verify this matches other diagnostic Observation maps.
cross_resource_issues.fix_recommendation: Ensure all diagnostic-related Observations use the same ConceptMap identifier for status consistency

cross_resource_issues.description: Multiple maps implement identical effective[x] modifierExtension patterns (valueSampledData, valueSignature, valueUsageContext) with 40-60 lines each of nearly identical code.
cross_resource_issues.fix_recommendation: Extract these patterns into reusable named groups that can be included via extends or rule reference to reduce maintenance burden and ensure consistent extension URL resolution
